Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

listings.description:
Principal Engineer

About this role

The bar has moved. Five years ago a strong engineer was measured by what they could build and how well they could mentor others to build it. Today, with Claude Code and agents, we produce quality work at a speed that would have looked superhuman in 2022 (Podium, PayPoint, Zuto, RL, OAG Analyser and others).

What separates exceptional from good is no longer typing speed or local craftsmanship. It is the complete package: architecture, deep engineering foundations, communication, system thinking, and the judgement to direct both your own intelligence and AI toward outcomes that matter.

Exceptional people at this level are not the best implementer in the room; they are the person whose specifications, decisions, and review judgement compound into systems that work in production and that others (and agents) can build on. They are a force multiplier, they hold a room at the highest levels, and clients treat them as the SME by default.

Your mindset

listings.title: Account Executive (AE) | DACH (d/f/m)
listings.description: About the role Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team. Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape. Who you are You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here You work in German and English at a professional level. Discovery, demos, and negotiation happen in German; the company runs in English Your potential growth path: Months 1-6: Master the product, close your first 5-10 deals, build your DACH network Months 6-18: Take on larger deals, navigate complex stakeholder environments, mentor BDRs

You do this in a profitable Munich scale-up with more than 250 people in five European locations: the pace of a fast-growing company and the stability to build things properly. As we are looking for a hands-on developer, a live coding session is an integral part of our interview process. Fleet Observability: Build monitoring that shows the health of every device in real time, from memory leaks to network stability and hardware metrics. listings.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. listings.title: DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
listings.description: Als DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Architektur, Automatisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer AWS-Umgebungen und entwickelst skalierbare Lösungen, die echten Business Impact erzeugen. Was du bei uns machst Du entwirfst und implementierst skalierbare, sichere und hochverfügbare Plattformarchitekturen auf AWS und anderen Cloud Providern und definierst Standards, Referenzarchitekturen und Best Practices. Du entwickelst und betreibst Plattform-Services wie Networking, IAM, Compute, Storage, Container und Serverless. Du treibst Automatisierung konsequent voran und entwickelst Infrastructure-as-Code-Lösungen (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK) sowie Self-Service-Frameworks. Du gestaltest und optimierst CI/CD-Pipelines, integrierst Security-, Compliance- und Quality-Checks und implementierst moderne Deployment-Strategien (Blue/Green, Canary, Rolling). Du entwickelst zentrale Automatisierungs-Tools und Plattformkomponenten in Python, erstellst APIs, CLI-Tools und wiederverwendbare Bibliotheken und nutzt AWS SDKs (boto3) effizient. Du stellst die Zuverlässigkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Performance der Plattform sicher und implementierst Monitoring, Observability sowie automatisierte Incident- und Recovery-Prozesse. Wann du zu uns passt Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Architektur, Entwicklung und Optimierung von AWS-Plattformen mit. Du hast fundiertes Wissen in Infrastructure as Code, Automatisierung und DevOps-Praktiken. Du bist sicher im Aufbau und Betrieb von Plattform-Services sowie CI/CD-Pipelines und Deployment-Strategien. Du verfügst über gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python und Erfahrung mit AWS SDKs, APIs und Automatisierungsframeworks. Du verstehst Monitoring, Observability und Cloud Operations als integrale Bestandteile einer stabilen Plattform. Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung mit Container-Technologien, Serverless-Architekturen und relevanten AWS-Zertifizierungen (z. B. AWS Solutions Architect Professional). Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englisch

listings.title: Azure Cloud Architect (m/w/d)
listings.description: Du möchtest komplexe Azure-Lösungen mit PaaS, IaaS und Containerdiensten entwickeln? Als technische/r Expert*in verstehst du die Kundenanforderungen und setzt diese ins technische Design um. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass unsere Projekte sichere, skalierbare und zuverlässige Azure-Lösungen liefern. About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it.

listings.title: Stage: Innovative Strategic Business Design
listings.description:
Jouw ideeën. Echte uitdagingen. Zichtbare impact. Welkom bij Lab271.

Ben jij een gedreven (master) student Industrial Design Engineering en op zoek naar een hands-on stage in strategic business design en innovatie, waarbij je écht het verschil kunt maken? Over Schuberg Philis

We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en beheren van cruciale computersystemen voor grote bedrijven, waaronder Geldmaat, ING en de Haven van Rotterdam. Over Lab271
Lab271 is het innovatielab waar toekomstgerichte oplossingen worden ontwikkeld voor uitdagende vraagstukken. Hier draait alles om experimenteren en het toepassen van opkomende technologieën om echte problemen aan te pakken. listings.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
listings.description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing

listings.title: Stage of Afstuderen: Optimalisatie van Machine-inspecties
listings.description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen Customer Service voert Voortman periodieke machine-inspecties uit om de technische staat van machines te beoordelen en klanten te adviseren over onderhoud, reparaties en mogelijke verbeteringen. Deze inspecties vormen een belangrijke basis voor het verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid, prestaties en levensduur van machines. Het huidige inspectieproces is door de jaren heen organisch gegroeid. Hierdoor worden inspectievragen niet altijd op dezelfde manier geïnterpreteerd, verschillen beoordelingen tussen monteurs en worden bevindingen niet overal uniform vastgelegd. Ook de rapportage richting klanten kan op onderdelen duidelijker, consistenter en meer actiegericht worden ingericht. Tijdens deze opdracht analyseer je het volledige machine-inspectieproces en ontwikkel je een vernieuwde werkwijze die aansluit bij de huidige en toekomstige behoeften van onze serviceorganisatie. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de inhoud van inspectievragen, maar ook naar de manier waarop inspecteurs informatie verzamelen, beoordelingen uitvoeren, bevindingen vastleggen en resultaten communiceren naar klanten. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het analyseren van het huidige machine-inspectieproces en het identificeren van verbeterpunten; Het ontwikkelen van een logische en uniforme structuur voor machine-inspecties; Het herformuleren en standaardiseren van bestaande inspectievragen; Het opstellen van duidelijke beoordelingscriteria voor de technische staat van machineonderdelen; Het ontwikkelen van een uniforme methode voor het vastleggen van metingen, bevindingen, foto's en aanbevolen acties; Het verbeteren van inspectierapportages zodat technische bevindingen overzichtelijk, eenduidig en actiegericht worden gepresenteerd; Het opstellen van een implementatievoorstel voor het vernieuwde inspectieproces binnen Customer Service. Het eindresultaat is een praktisch en onderbouwd verbeterplan waarmee Voortman machine-inspecties wereldwijd op een uniforme manier kan uitvoere
